items.title: File Einspruch against amended income tax assessment 2025
items.quote: Er ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Musterstadt-Nord schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated (posting day) 11.06.2026, a Thursday, sent by ordinary letter. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO as amended (posted on/after 1 Jan 2025), it counts as delivered on the 4th calendar day after posting: 12.06 (day1), 13.06 (day2), 14.06 (day3), 15.06.2026 (day4, Monday) = deemed Bekanntgabe. Since this is a Finanzamt, if that 4th day fell on a weekend/holiday it would move to the next working day under § 108 Abs. 3 AO, but 15.06.2026 is an ordinary Monday, so delivery stands at 15.06.2026. The one-month Einspruch period runs under § 355 Abs. 1 AO in conjunction with § 108 Abs. 1 AO and §§ 187, 188 BGB: the day of the event (delivery) is not counted for the start, and per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB the month-long period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event (15th) = 15.07.2026 (Wednesday), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW (Fronleichnam 2026 fell on 04.06.2026, unrelated), so no shift under § 108 Abs. 3 AO/§ 193 BGB is needed.
